# Optional torch backend for the embeddinggemma-2 preset (text + image + video + audio).
# MiniLM / Granite do NOT need any of this (they run on ONNX Runtime, requirements.txt).
#
#   pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-gemma.txt \
#       --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
#
# The --extra-index-url pulls the CPU-only torch wheel (~200 MB instead of the multi-GB CUDA build).
# Video/audio decoding uses an `ffmpeg` binary: the system one if on PATH, else the one bundled by imageio-ffmpeg.
torch==2.14.1
torchvision==0.29.1
transformers==5.19.0
sentence-transformers==6.1.0
safetensors==0.8.0
pillow==12.3.0
soundfile==0.14.0
imageio-ffmpeg==0.6.0
